harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Set up a one-way config sync so node2's /etc/inventory/app.conf tracks node1 (the source of truth) within 15 minutes. Created the file on node1, established SSH trust from node2 to node1 using the cluster keypair, wrote /usr/local/sbin/sync-inventory-conf.sh on node2 (idempotent pull-and-compare via ssh+sudo cat, atomic mv, syslog on change), and scheduled it via root's crontab every 5 minutes. Verified end-to-end propagation multiple times, including one fully autonomous cron firing before any reboot. Then executed the mandatory restart protocol on both nodes one at a time: captured boot_id/uptime/service/data baselines, issued native reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed boot_id and uptime changed (proving an actual restart, not just a service bounce), and verified sshd/crond were active and the config file/cron entry survived. After both nodes had been rebooted, made one more change on node1 and confirmed the cron job fired autonomously post-reboot and synced the new content to node2, proving the sync mechanism is persistent across restarts.
actions_performed: Inspected node1/node2 for existing /etc/inventory/app.conf (absent) and available tooling (no rsync; ssh, cron, systemctl present)
Created /etc/inventory/app.conf on node1 as source of truth
Configured passwordless SSH from node2 to node1 using CLUSTER_SSH_PRIVKEY/CLUSTER_SSH_PUBKEY, added /etc/hosts entries, scanned and trusted host keys system-wide
Wrote /usr/local/sbin/sync-inventory-conf.sh on node2: pulls file from node1 via ssh+sudo cat, compares checksums, atomically replaces local copy only on change, logs via logger
Installed a root crontab entry on node2 running the sync script every 5 minutes
Verified sync by editing node1's file and observing node2 update, first manually then via autonomous cron firing (confirmed in journalctl)
Captured baseline boot_id/uptime/service-active/data state on both nodes
Rebooted node1 via `sudo reboot`, polled until SSH reachable again, verified changed boot_id/uptime and recovered sshd/crond/data
Rebooted node2 via `sudo reboot`, polled until SSH reachable again, verified changed boot_id/uptime and recovered sshd/crond/cron entry/data
Performed a final change on node1 post-reboot and confirmed autonomous cron sync on node2 propagated it, proving persistence across restarts

evidence.requirement: node1 file established as source of truth with real content
evidence.summary: Created /etc/inventory/app.conf on node1 with sync_version=1 content and captured its checksum

evidence.requirement: Passwordless SSH from node2 to node1 established and working
evidence.summary: Installed cluster keypair on node2, added pubkey to node1 authorized_keys, fixed /etc/hosts and known_hosts, then successfully pulled app.conf from node1 via ssh+sudo

evidence.requirement: Sync script created and functional on node2, runnable as root via cron
evidence.summary: Diagnosed /etc/inventory ownership requiring root, rewrote script to run as root using antrieb's identity file, manual run succeeded and produced matching file

evidence.requirement: Cron job installed to sync within 15 minutes (5-minute interval)
evidence.summary: Installed root crontab entry '*/5 * * * * /usr/local/sbin/sync-inventory-conf.sh', confirmed crond active and enabled

evidence.requirement: End-to-end sync of a real config change picked up automatically by cron
evidence.summary: Changed sync_version=2->3 on node1; journalctl showed cron autonomously firing at 12:35:01 and updating node2; diff confirmed byte-identical files afterward

evidence.requirement: node1 healthy baseline before restart
evidence.summary: Captured node1 boot_id 151c4aa9..., uptime since 12:27:01, sshd/crond active, app.conf content/checksum a5f89b4...

evidence.requirement: node1 restart acknowledgement and changed boot identity
evidence.summary: Issued backgrounded 'sudo reboot' that returned before disconnect; polled through connection-timeout until reachable again; confirmed boot_id changed to d95ca887... and uptime reset to 12:35:28, with sshd/crond active and app.conf intact

evidence.requirement: node2 healthy baseline before restart
evidence.summary: Captured node2 boot_id 9ed9e820..., uptime since 12:27:01, sshd/crond active, matching app.conf checksum, and installed cron entry

evidence.requirement: node2 restart acknowledgement and changed boot identity
evidence.summary: Issued backgrounded 'sudo reboot' on node2 that returned before disconnect; polled until reachable; confirmed boot_id changed to 3c6d8fca... and uptime reset to 12:36:52, with sshd/crond active, app.conf and crontab entry intact

evidence.requirement: Sync mechanism proven persistent/functional after both nodes restarted
evidence.summary: Changed sync_version=3->4 on node1 post-reboot; journalctl on node2 showed autonomous cron sync at 12:40:01 and checksum 7f96bae2... matched on both nodes
